name: Almwirtschaft Achensee
kurzbeschreibung: Authentic alpine dairy farm high above **Achensee**, offering homemade **Almkäse** specialties, hearty **Bauerngröstl**, and breathtaking mountain views.
beschreibung: The Almwirtschaft Achensee in Pertisau is a charming alpine hut nestled in the breathtaking Tyrolean mountain landscape, offering pure, authentic alpine romance. Here, hikers and day-trippers enjoy a well-deserved break with stunning views of the surrounding peaks. The menu features hearty alpine specialties like homemade Kaiserschmarrn, spiced Almkäse with bread, and refreshing buttermilk—all prepared with products from the farm itself. The simple yet refined cuisine is the perfect reward after a hike. The sunny terrace invites you to linger, while the rustic interior provides warmth and coziness on cooler days. The Almwirtschaft Achensee is a slice of Tyrolean alpine culture you simply must experience.
